content: LibreOffice headless is the standard free DOCX->PDF path with generally high fidelity, but: missing fonts silently substitute (need fonts-crosextra-carlito/caladea for Calibri/Cambria metric compatibility or layout shifts), not thread-safe (one doc at a time), heavy cold starts in serverless containers, resource-hungry. Cloudflare Workers cannot run LibreOffice at all; needs a container/external service. Fidelity breaks most on text boxes, columns, custom fonts.
